name: epa-mcp-server
description: Search and retrieve EPA environmental data: facility compliance (ECHO), toxic releases (TRI), Superfund sites, drinking water systems, environmental-justice screening (EJScreen), and real-time air quality (AirNow). STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

AIRNOW_API_KEY.title: AirNow API Key
AIRNOW_API_KEY.description: Optional. Enables the epa_airnow_get_conditions tool when set; the other tools work without it. Free registration at docs.airnowapi.org.

EJSCREEN_API_BASE_URL.title: EJScreen (EJAM) API Base URL
EJSCREEN_API_BASE_URL.description: Optional. Override the EJScreen data endpoint used by epa_ejscreen_get_scores. Defaults to https://api.ejanalysis.com — the community-maintained EJScreen rehost by Public Environmental Data Partners.

EPA_CLAMP_LIMITS.title: Clamp Count Inputs
EPA_CLAMP_LIMITS.description: Optional. true (default) serves a count input such as limit above its cap at the cap with a notice; false makes each cap a strict maximum, so a larger value fails validation.
